--- title: "Packages" description: "Explore the OpenRBQM ecosystem of open-source R packages for RBQM." --- # Overview The OpenRBQM framework is designed to provide a robust and flexible solution for risk-based quality management. It includes a variety of packages that help streamline processes and ensure compliance with industry standards. # The {gsm} Ecosystem The `{gsm.core}` package is a successor to `{gsm}`, which was **deprecated in March 2025**. The contents of `{gsm}` were split into a family of focused packages, each owning one part of the risk-based monitoring workflow. ## Package lineage ```{mermaid} flowchart TD gsm["gsm
deprecated Mar 2025"]:::deprecated gsm --> core["gsm.core
analytics engine"] gsm --> workr["workr
workflow runtime"] gsm --> mapping["gsm.mapping
data transformation"] gsm --> kri["gsm.kri
metrics & visualization"] gsm --> reporting["gsm.reporting
reporting data model"] classDef deprecated fill:#dc3545,stroke:#a71d2a,color:#fff; ``` ## How the packages fit together Together the successor packages form a pipeline that turns raw clinical data into monitoring reports. `{workr}` executes the YAML-defined workflows that drive each step, and `{gsm.core}` provides the analytics used to construct and evaluate the metrics. ```{mermaid} flowchart LR raw[("Raw / source
datasets")] --> mapping["gsm.mapping
map to domains"] mapping --> kri["gsm.kri
generate & visualize metrics"] kri --> reporting["gsm.reporting
reporting data model"] reporting --> reports[["Reports"]] core["gsm.core
analytics engine"] -. "metric analytics" .-> kri workr["workr
workflow runtime"] -. "executes workflows" .-> mapping workr -.-> kri workr -.-> reporting classDef runtime fill:#0d6efd,stroke:#0a58ca,color:#fff; class workr,core runtime; ``` ## Package roles | Package | Role | |---|---| | **`{gsm.core}`** | Analytics functionality used to construct and evaluate metrics. | | **`{workr}`** | Workflow runtime that executes YAML-defined steps and workflows. | | **`{gsm.mapping}`** | Workflows that transform raw/source datasets into the appropriate domains. | | **`{gsm.kri}`** | Workflows to generate metrics, plus functionality to visualize and report on them. | | **`{gsm.reporting}`** | Workflows to build the reporting data model needed to generate reports. | # Packages ## Core Packages ::: {.grid} ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4} ::: {.card .h-100 .nav-card} ::: {.card-body} #### [gsm.core](https://github.com/Gilead-BioStats/gsm.core) The Good Statistical Monitoring or 'gsm' suite of R packages provides a framework for statistical data monitoring. 'gsm.core' provides the analytics framework for constructing metrics, and the utility functions to run workflows. [Website](https://gilead-biostats.github.io/gsm.core) ::: ::: ::: ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4} ::: {.card .h-100 .nav-card} ::: {.card-body} #### [workr](https://github.com/Gilead-BioStats/workr) Simple Workflows in R [Website](https://gilead-biostats.github.io/workr/) ::: ::: ::: ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4} ::: {.card .h-100 .nav-card} ::: {.card-body} #### [gsm.mapping](https://github.com/Gilead-BioStats/gsm.mapping) Data mapping framework for {gsm} [Website](https://gilead-biostats.github.io/gsm.mapping/) ::: ::: ::: ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4} ::: {.card .h-100 .nav-card} ::: {.card-body} #### [gsm.kri](https://github.com/Gilead-BioStats/gsm.kri) Provides workflows to generate metrics and functionality to visualize and report on these metrics. [Website](https://gilead-biostats.github.io/gsm.kri/) ::: ::: ::: ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4} ::: {.card .h-100 .nav-card} ::: {.card-body} #### [gsm.reporting](https://github.com/Gilead-BioStats/gsm.reporting) Provides workflows to generate the reporting data model needed to generate reports. [Website](https://gilead-biostats.github.io/gsm.reporting/) ::: ::: ::: ::: ## Extensions and Data ::: {.grid} ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4} ::: {.card .h-100 .nav-card} ::: {.card-body} #### [gsm.qtl](https://github.com/Gilead-BioStats/gsm.qtl) No Description Provided [Website](https://gilead-biostats.github.io/gsm.qtl/) ::: ::: ::: ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4} ::: {.card .h-100 .nav-card} ::: {.card-body} #### [gsm.viz](https://github.com/Gilead-BioStats/gsm.viz) web-based data viz for risk-based monitoring [Website](https://gilead-biostats.github.io/gsm.viz/) ::: ::: ::: ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4} ::: {.card .h-100 .nav-card} ::: {.card-body} #### [clindata](https://github.com/Gilead-BioStats/clindata) Synthetic Data for testing and development [Website](https://gilead-biostats.github.io/clindata/) ::: ::: ::: ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4} ::: {.card .h-100 .nav-card} ::: {.card-body} #### [gsm.datasim](https://github.com/Gilead-BioStats/gsm.datasim) Generates synthetic test data for the RBQM of Clinical Trials based on several parameters.
